title: fix(rest): the API-exposure gate reads the one object it checks, by name, instead of every object's metadata on each /data request
body:
Fixes #24031

Clause-②: no

Basis for the Clause-② line: the gate answers every request as before, with the same 405s, the same fail-open and the same answer for an unknown object; only the read behind the verdict changes, and no schema, published text or accept set moves. For a denied operation on an object whose package is disabled, the refusal's `status` and `code` change: FROM `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` TO the exposure verdict (`405 OBJECT_API_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED`, or `404 OBJECT_API_DISABLED` for `apiEnabled: false`). No accepted request becomes refused and no refused request becomes accepted (seat ruling `6226615729`, Q2 → B).

## What changed

- **`packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`, `enforceApiAccess` only.** The gate asks the protocol's by-name read, `getMetaItem({ type: 'object', name })`, for the one object in the path. It sends the same env-scoped request shape the list read sends, and it no longer calls `loadObjectItems`. A protocol with no by-name read is asked the list, as before.
- **`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`: `loadObjectItem`, beside `loadObjectItems`.**
  - A thrown read fails open and logs the same `api-exposure gate` warning (#3545).
  - No item behind the name means no policy, and nothing is logged.
  - An item counts only under its own name, the same match the list search made.
  - `MetaReadGateListSource` gains one optional by-name method, `getObjectItem`.
  - `loadObjectItems` is unchanged for the batch route and the nav-servability gate. One docblock sentence no longer names this gate as a caller.
  - Nothing is cached, so a metadata change applies from the next request.
- **Pin: `packages/rest/src/rest-exposure-gate-one-object-read.test.ts` (37 tests).** It runs the real protocol over a real `SchemaRegistry`, both unscoped and environment-scoped. It pins:
  - a `/data` list, get, create, update and delete each make zero `getMetaItems` calls, and therefore run no list-wide diagnostic pass;
  - the 404/405 answers for a code-registered object, a stored environment object and an object another package extends (an extension carries no `enable`, because `ObjectExtensionSchema` is strict);
  - an unknown object is still answered by the data path's own 404, with nothing logged;
  - a throwing by-name read fails open and logs;
  - a protocol with no by-name read is still asked the list;
  - for a disabled package's object, one DENIED operation (405) and one ALLOWED operation (still `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`).
- **Doubles (seat ruling Q1 → A): `rest.test.ts`, `rest-bulk-path-object.test.ts`, `rest-export-permission-gate.test.ts`.** Each double's `getMetaItem` now answers the object its own `getMetaItems` holds. On the real protocol the two reads agree for every one of 104 showcase objects. The diff touches double setup only: no changed line contains `expect(`, `it(`, `describe(`, `toBe` or `toEqual`.
- **`packages/runtime/src/domains/data-write-request-gate.test.ts`, its rig only (Q1 A extended, `6227635439`).** The rig's real protocol has no metadata store, so its by-name read threw and the gate failed open on 12 exposure rows. Its `getMetaItem` now answers the same registry definition its `getMetaItems` override holds; every other type keeps the real read. No assertion changed. The earlier rounds' "existing exposure tests" grep named only `packages/rest`, and this rig sat outside it. A census of every non-rest test that constructs `RestServer` found it the only member of the class.
- **`scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json`.** One entry, generated by `check-engine-double-contract --write` for the new pin file. The seat declared it on #6017 (comment `6226622031`).
- **`.changeset/24031-exposure-gate-one-object-read.md`** (`@objectstack/rest` patch): the latency gain, the one status/code change (FROM/TO), and `Clause-②: no`.

## Measurements (showcase, `bootShowcase`, shared box)

- **Object-list reads per `/data` request**, base gate → head: 1 → 0. Measured on list, get, create, update, delete, a refused request, a stored object and an unknown object.
- **33 × `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_account?limit=5`**: 2421 ms → 647 ms in total, median 71.7 → 19.5 ms (-73 %).
- **The read behind the gate**: the list read has a median of 56-61 ms; the by-name read has a median of 4.5 ms. One by-name read makes 0 calls to `getMetaItems`, `readFlattenedMetaItems` and `registry.listItems('object')`.
- **Agreement of the two reads** (before the merge, at `e10990366`; the merge brought no hunk inside `getMetaItems`, `readFlattenedMetaItems` or `getMetaItem`):
  - 104 objects (68 of them API-restricted), on an unscoped and an env-scoped protocol: `enable` is deep-equal for every one;
  - a stored env object is equal in both reads;
  - a draft-only object is absent from both;
  - a stored row under a packaged object's name is declined by both;
  - an unknown object: `getMetaItem` does not throw, and its envelope has no `item`;
  - the one class that differs is a disabled package's object (see the Basis).
- **Disabled-package doors** (`com.objectstack.plugin-auth` disabled), base tree `e246f0611` → head `e238774dd`:
  - `POST /api/v1/data/sys_api_key`: `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` → `405 OBJECT_API_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED`;
  - `GET /api/v1/data/sys_api_key`: `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` at both.

Re-measuring the Rerun Safety file of #23977 is the seat's step once this lands; #23977 stays open here.

## Tests (at `70eca6c17`; the `@objectstack/rest` readings are at `e238774dd`, whose rest sources are the same)

- **This round, at `70eca6c17`:**
  - full `@objectstack/runtime` local project: Test Files 405 passed (405); Tests 6175 passed | 19 skipped;
  - `@objectstack/http-conformance`: 14 files, 150 passed;
  - the runtime rig: 73 / 73, with 0 gate fault lines, and 73 / 73 under the ablation too, so its verdict rows hold under both reads;
  - `@objectstack/runtime` typecheck exit 0, with the debt ledger unchanged.
- **Full `@objectstack/rest` local suite**: Test Files 290 passed (290); Tests 5990 passed | 326 skipped; `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- **The pin file plus the 3 ruled files**: 4 files passed, 265 tests passed.
- **`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest typecheck`**: exit 0, including `check:test-typecheck` with 0 debt.
- **Ablation at `e238774dd`**:
  - Mutation: `enforceApiAccess` put back on `loadObjectItems` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `ffc716c6a290` → `b429a90b19d3`). The dist preflight found the marker, exit 0.
  - Result: 17 failed | 248 passed. Red: the zero-read rows, the refused-request zero-read rows, the asks-by-name rows and the throwing-by-name rows in both scopes (16), plus the disabled-package DENIED row (its base answer is `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`). Green: every answer row, and all 228 tests of the 3 ruled files, so their doubles keep their verdicts under both reads.
  - Restore: blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty; the preflight with `--absent` exits 0; 265 passed.
- **The implementation alone** (before the doubles, at `3f612b8d5`): the 9 tests in those 3 files went red, and the rest of the suite was green.
- **`test:repo`** was not run locally, because the diff touches none of its files. CI's `Test Core` runs it.

## Gates (at `70eca6c17`)

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 75 families, the same set as at `e238774dd`. All 75 were re-run at `70eca6c17` and every one exited 0; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` was included and ran after a full build. The `--ran` reconciliation exited 0.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over the 6 changed TypeScript files exited 0. The repo-wide lint is the `Lint & Repo Gates` check-run's.

## Acceptance notes

- Three other paths still read the whole object list on every request (not measured):
  - `POST /api/v1/data/batch`, which reads it once for all its operations and is held off by the ruling;
  - the anonymous form doors: `readFormObjectDefinitions`, and the form schema read, which lists every object to find one.
- **Registry hydration.** On an UNSCOPED kernel, the list read hydrates stored rows into the registry, and the gate no longer triggers that on every request. The designed paths still do it:
  - the save write-through (#4521): a stored object answered 200 on `/data` at head;
  - boot hydration;
  - the cluster lane `metadata.mutated`.

  Standalone serve boots are env-scoped (`env_local`), where that hydration never ran.
- Two docblocks still name this gate as a list caller: the private `loadObjectItems` docblock in `rest-server.ts`, which is outside this surface, and the `meta-overlay-cache.ts` header in `packages/metadata-protocol`, which is held off.
- **The disagreement the Q2 ruling leaves to another lane.** The by-name read serves a disabled package's object while the list omits it; the READERS table of #7557 classifies neither. Measured with `com.objectstack.plugin-auth` disabled, identical at base `e246f0611` and head `e238774dd`:
  - `GET /api/v1/meta/object/sys_api_key` answers 200 and serves the object;
  - `GET /api/v1/meta/objects` and `GET /api/v1/meta/object` answer 200 with 73 items, and `sys_api_key` is absent (103 items while the package is enabled).

  The seat files this as its own card.
